name: search-object
title: Search for an object
description: Find an object whose location is unknown: visit the supports of a room in order of distance and aim the head at each surface until the object is seen.
use_when: The location of an object is unknown in the current room.

not_to_be_confused_with.explore: explore covers a room without a target.

region.description: Room to search; default the robot's room.

found_on.description: Support under the object when it was seen.

postconditions.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
